title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned The Register. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Register
options.lineage: Museum collection registers and catalogues raisonnés (Nationalmuseet, Designmuseum Danmark)
options.thesis: Every token and component is an accessioned object: numbered, described, with provenance and condition.
options.viewport: Catalogue title page: a monumental grotesk section word on a full-width mount band, accession index down the margin, serif reading column at 66ch.
options.risk: If the catalogue apparatus is applied to every element it reads as museum costume instead of documentation.

raised.raise: Total commitment: each section's mount hue owns its whole masthead band, never scattered as accents.
State is drawn in form (rule weight, fill, strike), never by colour alone.
Every component plate is shown as registered views: rendered object and its source, aligned on one baseline.
One word big enough to win: each section opens on a single monumental word, nothing competing.
One vertical accession rail rules the page; every entry hangs from its number.

options.label: Grotesk Specimen
options.lineage: Swiss foundry type specimens and the International Typographic Style
options.thesis: The system as a type specimen: monumental grotesk, strict 12-column grid, one navy ink.
options.viewport: A 12-column sheet with the section name at 11rem, scale ladder beside a serif reading column.
options.risk: The closest to Kronborg and to where most design-system sites land; reads as homage more than authorship.

options.label: Acetate Tab Manual
options.lineage: Boxed-software reference manuals with coloured divider boards
options.thesis: The system as a reference manual: one divider hue per section, content on milk-acetate leaves, a stepped tab rail sized by extent.
options.viewport: Chrome-yellow Components board, an acetate leaf over it carrying the reading column, tab rail down the right edge.
options.case: Fuses well: sections map to divider tabs and the rail is excellent wayfinding; loses on identification with the references.
options.risk: Seven saturated section hues fight dashboards and slides built on top of the system.

options.label: Normalled Jackfield
options.thesis: Every setting tied to its default by an amber link line.
options.viewport: Numbered amber lanes on black glass.
options.case: Fuses poorly: a studio instrument worn as costume on a reading surface.
options.kept: State drawn in form, never colour alone.

options.label: Cutting Bench
options.thesis: Sections strung along a perforated rail.
options.viewport: A perforated rail across a grain-orange field.
options.case: Fuses poorly: no tie to the owner's references.
options.risk: Orange at a third of every screen breaks dashboards.
options.kept: Total palette commitment at page scale.

options.label: Curved Crease
options.thesis: Layout ruled by one sweeping arc.
options.viewport: A cream disc lifting along one charcoal arc.
options.case: Fuses poorly: an arc cannot rule a docs grid.
options.risk: Cream and italic serif: the default look.

options.label: Mesophotic Dive
options.thesis: Descend through the system by depth.
options.case: Fuses poorly: depth is a metaphor the reader must learn.
options.kept: One vertical axis ruling every line.

options.label: Fly-posted Flyer
options.thesis: A collage plane with one calm white panel.
options.case: Fuses poorly: loud where the references are calm.
options.kept: One word big enough to win.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A modern design-system docs site, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Left sidebar tree, page title, live preview with code below.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other design-system site by design.
